int http_post(const char *host, int port, const char *path, const char *body) {
    int s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    connect(s, host, port);
    char req[2048];
    snprintf(req, sizeof(req), "POST %s HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: %s\r\n\r\n%s", path, host, body);
    send(s, req, strlen(req), 0);
    recv_until_headers(s);
    parse_status_line();
    close_socket(s);
    return 0;
}
